edition: Effective Fall 2025; current AP Central CED and clarifications reviewed
scope: Initial four-game release. Classifications apply only to listed reading/interpretation/debugging modes; code-writing objectives are intentionally practiced through SkillStruck. This is not complete AP CSA or EOP coverage. The district EOP blueprint was not supplied. char is included for broader Java/EOP foundations.
